# Namepass developer documentation

> Integrate USDC funding for ENS renewals with activated deposit addresses, private transfer references and verified settlement tracking. API version 2026-09-28. Testnet availability is controlled by the operator; docs availability is not a mainnet launch.

## Guides and API operations

- [Introduction](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/introduction.md): Add ENS renewals to your app, with a deposit address and proof of settlement.
- [Quickstart](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/quickstart.md): Connect a customer's ENS name to your payment and reconciliation systems.
- [Authentication & conventions](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/contract.md): Keys, scopes, idempotency, amounts and pagination.
- [Deposit addresses](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/addresses.md): Activate a name, retrieve its address and verify its ENS alias.
- [Funding estimates](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/quotes.md): Get an exact, block-pinned estimate before funding.
- [Track a transfer](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/transfers.md): Give your payment a private reference and verify its transaction.
- [Understand settlement](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/settlement.md): Distinguish a verified deposit, pooled consumption and a finalized renewal.
- [Sync & replay](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/sync.md): Bootstrap a consistent snapshot and resume all changes by cursor.
- [Receive webhooks](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/webhooks.md): Verify signatures, deduplicate events and recover delivery.
- [Recover a flow](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/recovery.md): Resume existing activity without sending funds twice.
- [Availability & support](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/release.md): Check deployment readiness and get help with a request.
- [Build with your agent](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/agents.md): Give your coding agent the Namepass contract and a focused integration workflow.
- [Docs MCP server](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/mcp.md): Search guides, read pages and inspect API operations from your editor.
- [Integration skill](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/skills.md): Install reusable guidance for building a correct Namepass integration.
- [API overview](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference.md): Explore every operation and the generated OpenAPI contract.
- [Discover the active deployment and supported funding modes](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_config.md): GET /api/v1/config
- [Activate a name and create the caller’s watch](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_names_activate.md): POST /api/v1/names/activate
- [Read a durable operation](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_activations__id_.md): GET /api/v1/activations/{id}
- [Read stored name, alias verification, balance snapshots and history coverage](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_names__name_.md): GET /api/v1/names/{name}
- [Refresh ENS and chain coverage asynchronously](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_names__name__refresh.md): POST /api/v1/names/{name}/refresh
- [List the caller’s enabled name watches](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_watches.md): GET /api/v1/watches
- [Watch an activated name; bootstrap with /sync](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/put_watches__name_.md): PUT /api/v1/watches/{name}
- [Stop new notifications for a name](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/delete_watches__name_.md): DELETE /api/v1/watches/{name}
- [Quote an exact input amount at a verified hub block](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_quotes.md): POST /api/v1/quotes
- [Register a transaction attempt with a private stable reference](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_transfers.md): POST /api/v1/transfers
- [List complete transfers at a fixed publication position](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_transfers.md): GET /api/v1/transfers
- [Add a replacement hash or choose a receipt log](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_transfers__id__transactions.md): POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/transactions
- [Read one transfer](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_transfers__id_.md): GET /api/v1/transfers/{id}
- [List complete deposits at a fixed publication position](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_deposits.md): GET /api/v1/deposits
- [Read one deposit](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_deposits__id_.md): GET /api/v1/deposits/{id}
- [List complete flows at a fixed publication position](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_flows.md): GET /api/v1/flows
- [Read one flow](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_flows__id_.md): GET /api/v1/flows/{id}
- [List complete settlements at a fixed publication position](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_settlements.md): GET /api/v1/settlements
- [Read one settlement](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_settlements__id_.md): GET /api/v1/settlements/{id}
- [Revalidate and resume the same flow](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_flows__id__retry.md): POST /api/v1/flows/{id}/retry
- [Create a consistent snapshot and matching event cursor](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_sync.md): POST /api/v1/sync
- [Page an immutable snapshot for up to 24 hours](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_sync__id_.md): GET /api/v1/sync/{id}
- [Replay events; persist nextCursor only after durable processing](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_events.md): GET /api/v1/events
- [Read an event available to this partner](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_events__id_.md): GET /api/v1/events/{id}
- [List webhook destinations](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_webhook_endpoints.md): GET /api/v1/webhook-endpoints
- [Register an unverified HTTPS webhook destination](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_webhook_endpoints.md): POST /api/v1/webhook-endpoints
- [Read a webhook destination](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_webhook_endpoints__id_.md): GET /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}
- [Edit destination or subscription; pending deliveries pause](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/patch_webhook_endpoints__id_.md): PATCH /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}
- [Disable a destination](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/delete_webhook_endpoints__id_.md): DELETE /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}
- [Send a signed synthetic test event](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_webhook_endpoints__id__test.md): POST /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}/test
- [Activate a destination after it accepts a signed verification event](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_webhook_endpoints__id__verify.md): POST /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}/verify
- [Rotate signing secret with a 24-hour overlap](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_webhook_endpoints__id__rotate_secret.md): POST /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}/rotate-secret
- [List delivery outcomes](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_webhook_deliveries.md): GET /api/v1/webhook-deliveries
- [Read a delivery and its recent attempts](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_webhook_deliveries__id_.md): GET /api/v1/webhook-deliveries/{id}
- [Replay the immutable original event](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_webhook_deliveries__id__replay.md): POST /api/v1/webhook-deliveries/{id}/replay
